steps.name: Hildisvini of Freia (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Freya] in the "compartment", catch [Red Hildisvini] in "Moros" to obtain [Freya's Red Hildisvini]. Then report to [Freya] in “Compartment 2”.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: In hydroponic farms, disobedient machines are not enough. There has to be something more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel something ominous... .

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahahaha. came? Welcome! nice to meet you! I’m so glad to see you!!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Black... . I've been wanting to see you for so long, but you didn't come to see me. Do you know that I haven't been here in almost 10 years?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, 10 years? I’m not fooled by things like that.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Sheesh. They don't even accept the tragic heroine. This is sad. Nyahahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you called me.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: These days, only Saraswati is looking for me and I am not even looking for her, so I am upset. Pooh.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I'm also bored right now. If I die, I might die of boredom!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You say the same thing as someone I know... .

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Pooh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is such a person.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I see. There is someone similar to me. So that's it. I'm so bored. I'm so tired of staying in this boring place with Warsam and Kerdol.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: So yooooooo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, please don't talk too long. Please. I feel like I'm feeling down... .

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehe, so! I have a favor to ask you! I heard from Saraswati that I recently went to a place where there were a lot of cool pigs!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: No, I just secretly opened the protocol... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Freya, I haven’t seen you like that, but you are a scary person… .

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Kyahaha♡, I’m not human. Thank you for treating me like a human!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, by the way, why are there wild boars in the Moros area?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Please bring me those pigs!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Pigs are my friends!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I have no idea!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehe, no more, no less, please catch 30 wild boars wandering around the fields in that neighborhood♡

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I think this hydroponic farm will be fun then!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wouldn’t Keudori and Warsam be against it?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: It's okay! If you don't listen to them anyway, they'll tear up all your circuits!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: When you come back, I'll tell you why. Adventurer will understand if you listen! Nyahaha!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I doubt it, but I'll give it a go. Then we need to talk about it properly!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: It's a promise! Then come back quickly!

steps.name: Hildisvini of Freia (2)
steps.objective: In "Dreaming Oneiro", defeat [Blue Healdis Viny] and [Purple Healdis Vinny] and obtain [Freya's Blue Healdis Vinny] and [Freya's Purple Healdis Vinny]. Then report to [Freya] in “Compartment 2”.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Wow! You have come!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you ask me to catch these wild boars for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Give Freya several Hildis beanie that were caught.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehehe, hehehe. What a beautiful and great-looking wild boar!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: You know me, right? I am the master!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Okay, I'll give you a new name! Because I forgot everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Your name is Geumdong, your name is %s, your name is Babting… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there was my name in the middle... .

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Sheesh, the boar’s name is %s… , it was just right... . I could have just passed on... .(muttering)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, as promised, tell me why you asked me to bring you the wild boars.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Not enough. There aren't enough pigs... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: There aren't enough pigs.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, what does that mean?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: We need kids of different colors. Wow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Catch more wild boars?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Bingo! As expected from %s! If you catch two more species of wild boars with different colors! I especially give you my autograph!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No need to sign, just say why.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Let me tell you a story that Saraswati doesn’t know! So is it okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I doubt it... .

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: There's nothing I can do if I don't like it. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will come back. Then I promise. This is the last time.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehehe, I promise. Nyahahaha.

steps.name: Hildisvini of Freia (3)
steps.objective: After talking to [Freya] in "Compartment 2", go to [Ishtar] in "Compartment 1".

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Wow! Here you go again!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As promised, a total of 40 wild boars... . It's here.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work! Nyahaha.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: At this level, these children will be able to live well here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then will you tell me as you promised?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: A promise is a promise, so I’ll tell you!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Originally, these children came with the people of Asgard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: They were raised together as a kind of emergency food.
(Hildisvini, who was in front of Freya,'s expression hardens.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahahaha, don’t be scared! There's no one here to eat you anyway... . Oh, are you here?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: There was a hole in the ship and the pigs flew out into space... . Ah, I thought my relationship with them was over.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: But! Hahaha. How much time has passed? The children's children's children's... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, you are the descendants of those children, right?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: No. The children's children's children's... I thought that was the case, but it was just those kids!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying those kids are the kids from back then?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yep! At first, I thought I should just raise pigs, but when I looked closer, I realized it was that kid! We broke up a really long time ago, how can we still stay together?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: These guys have gained so much weight! I grew it a lot... .
(Hildisvini, who was in front of Freya, looks very nervous.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I need to grow a lot of them and ride them around in a hydroponic farm. Nyahang♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Freya, I'm going.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: On the way, I say hello to Ishtar. I guess I still have something to say. Nyaha! Stand there, you pigs!! I will catch them all and punish them☆

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: It's been a while. You've been very busy recently, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. A lot has already happened.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I heard roughly what happened through Saraswati. Maybe we were involved, but I couldn't care less.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Just your heart is enough.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: It will be more helpful in your work in the future. I promise.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: This is important for you and for us. Maybe we can solve the truth of this world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel reassured.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Say hello to that kid too. The thing you've been looking for so long, that can save this world... .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Ah, now she must be the goddess of this star.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Anyway, from now on, please do what only you can do. We will find a way to help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Uh, okay. It's been a while since I've seen you, but it seems like your personality has become quite impatient... . I'm already leaving.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hahaha! Catch me! These pigs. Why are you running away like this? Nyahahahah!♡

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I have to believe that he left early because he didn't want to see me. Sigh. Are there any records of the Galactic War? .

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahahahah!♡

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: (Freya is running around like crazy trying to catch Hildisvini.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I'm worried, but it's been a while since Freya went on a rampage like that, so I guess I'll just leave it alone.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahahahah! ♡ Let’s never break up again!
